events.description: Frame f4 shows a sudden bright orange-yellow flash with linear streaks (likely shattered windshield glass), followed by full-frame saturation in f5, consistent with a near-instantaneous energy release viewed from inside a vehicle.

verification.reason: f4 (27.5 s) displays abrupt intense light and debris-like streaks; f5 (28.0 s) is uniformly yellow-orange saturated—indicative of a blast flash; f6–f8 show a damaged, obscured windshield with residual haze but no evidence of vehicle-to-vehicle contact or deformation required for CarAccident. Explosion is the only supported category per definitions; sustained fire alone is insufficient, but the instantaneous onset and light saturation meet explosion criteria.
